outgoing.name: Mining
outgoing.excerpt: Soweto and the south-eastern suburbs, located in Region 6 and Region 10, border the city's mining belt in the north.

outgoing.name: Nelson Mandela
outgoing.excerpt: Nelson Mandela has a house in Houghton, and it is also the location of the most prestigious secondary schools in Johannesburg.

outgoing.name: Police
outgoing.excerpt: The municipal functions for the area, such as police and social services, are still managed by either the local region or the city government.

outgoing.name: World War II
outgoing.excerpt: The South African economy did extremely well at the end of World War II and many new immigrants came to South Africa from Europe.
